propositions: AGENTS.md incorrectly claims the start-work-gate --force flag is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the shipped MCP surface and the 2026-08-18 operator ruling.
docs/user-guide.md incorrectly claims the rebar claim --force flag is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the shipped code.
The force flag must be documented as available on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with auditability enforced by the absence of a signed attestation, not by withholding the capability.
CI pipelines can enforce certification gates by checking for the absence of a signed attestation on forced writes.
The MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py were already corrected to reflect the force-everywhere model, but the canonical prose documentation has not been updated to match.
